turns.speaker: alice
turns.text: I finally adopted a golden retriever puppy from the shelter and named him Biscuit.

turns.speaker: bob
turns.text: That's wonderful news! How is the training going so far?

turns.speaker: alice
turns.text: Biscuit already learned to sit, and my sourdough starter finally doubled overnight.

turns.speaker: bob
turns.text: I signed up for the Rotterdam marathon happening this October.

turns.speaker: alice
turns.text: Impressive, I could never manage a distance like that.

turns.speaker: bob
turns.text: My physiotherapist recommended zinc supplements for my knee tendonitis.

turns.speaker: alice
turns.text: Hope the knee holds up through all those kilometers.

turns.speaker: bob
turns.text: I finished refurbishing the vintage Olivetti typewriter I found at the flea market.

turns.speaker: alice
turns.text: Does it actually still type properly?

turns.speaker: bob
turns.text: Perfectly. I wrote my grandmother a letter on it yesterday.

turns.speaker: alice
turns.text: Sweet of you. Meanwhile Biscuit chewed through my headphone cable.

turns.speaker: bob
turns.text: Ha! Anyway, I booked flights to Reykjavik to see the northern lights in November.

turns.speaker: alice
turns.text: Iceland is amazing, pack plenty of thermal layers.

turns.speaker: bob
turns.text: Will do. My long run reached thirty kilometers this week.

turns.speaker: alice
turns.text: Big news: I got promoted to senior data engineer at Meridian Analytics.

turns.speaker: bob
turns.text: Congratulations, you absolutely earned that.

turns.speaker: alice
turns.text: Thanks! We celebrated with fondue at the little Swiss place downtown.

turns.speaker: bob
turns.text: Nice. My Reykjavik itinerary now includes the Blue Lagoon.

turns.speaker: alice
turns.text: Biscuit graduated from puppy obedience class on Saturday.

turns.speaker: bob
turns.text: A scholar! I also sold the typewriter to a collector for four hundred euros.
